description: Quotes the SOL cost of an NFTm launch from pictures and an optional traits spreadsheet. Uses the same published figures as the NFTm launch cost calculator. This tool does not upload files and does not need a wallet.

bytesBase64.description: Raw image bytes as base64. Optional when sizeBytes alone is enough for a quote.

sizeBytes.description: Size in bytes. Required when bytesBase64 is omitted.

url.description: https URL of the image. Optional.

name: nftm_quote_launch
title: Quote an NFTm launch
